channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse marks 165 years of guiding ships along Florida coast
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse has been guiding ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years since its construction in 1860.

item.title: New Aldi opens in Hobe Sound as Treasure Coast shoppers face rising grocery costs
item.description: A new Aldi at 8867 Southeast Bridge Road in Hobe Sound opened Thursday, bringing more affordable grocery options to Martin County customers facing tight budgets as the USDA expects grocery prices to rise 2.8% this year.

item.description: A WalletHub study released this month ranked Port St. Lucie as the 67th most stressed city in the United States and 42nd most financially stressed in America.

item.title: Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse offers 165 years of history with 105-step climb
item.description: The Jupiter Inlet Lighthouse, built in 1860, has guided ships along Florida's Atlantic coast for more than 165 years. The 105-step climb offers panoramic views of the Atlantic Ocean, Jupiter Inlet, Loxahatchee River and Indian River.

item.title: Karolina Muchova defeats Coco Gauff in dramatic Wimbledon semifinal tiebreaker
item.description: Karolina Muchova ended Coco Gauff's run at Wimbledon with a 6-2, 1-6, 7-6 (10) victory Thursday that ended with a drama-filled tiebreaker.

item.title: Women's Professional Baseball League unveils team names and logos ahead of August debut season
item.description: The Women's Professional Baseball League released the nicknames and logos of its four teams ahead of its inaugural season, with each team name inspired by pioneering women.
